decisions.reason: As the flagship of the announced enterprise messaging direction, with heavy public commitment and investment behind it, management will persist despite the lack of recent website visibility and attribute any weakness to temporary market conditions.
Its dedicated page and fit with the electronic document workflow strategy justify continuing, although the missing website presence in 2020 and 2021 raises some doubt about its traction.

Email and fax conversion still serves regulated customers at low marginal cost, but fax is declining and the related fax feature D has already been dropped, which makes this the weakest candidate for continued persistence.
Sandbox threat protection is central to the security positioning the firm presents as a key competitive argument, so strategic commitment and rising threat levels favor keeping it.
Multi-engine scanning is an expected part of secure email, so withdrawing it would undermine the firm's security claims, though it may eventually be bundled into the sandbox offering.
